metadata.description: Stable Audio 3 Small Music Base audio outpainting is the foundational 459 million parameter checkpoint that extends music tracks via causal continuation guided by text prompts.
metadata.display_name: Stable Audio 3 Small Music Base Audio Outpainting

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

bitrate.description: Audio bitrate for compressed output formats (e.g., mp3, aac, opus). Format e.g. '192k' or '320k'. Ignored for lossless formats (wav, flac).
bitrate.title: Bitrate

enable_prompt_expansion.description: If True, the prompt will be expanded using an LLM for more detailed and higher quality results.

extend_seconds_after.description: Seconds of new audio to generate after the source audio.
extend_seconds_after.title: Extend Seconds After

extend_seconds_before.description: Seconds of new audio to generate before the source audio.
extend_seconds_before.title: Extend Seconds Before

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Higher values follow the prompt more strictly; ~7.0 is a good starting point for base checkpoints.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

negative_prompt.description: Text description of qualities to avoid in the output.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

num_inference_steps.description: Number of sampling steps. Base (non-distilled) checkpoints typically need ~50 for good quality.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

output_format.description: Container format for the generated audio output.
output_format.title: Output Format

prompt.description: Text description guiding the extension content.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible outputs. Omit for a random seed.

sync_mode.description: If True, the audio is returned inline as a data URI and the result is not saved to the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

seed.description: The random seed used for generation.
